narrative.overview:
Every station is two lanes: yours, and your partner studio's. Lettering and argument on your lane; the partner's matter level with it on the partner lane. One pink live line starts under the wordmark, crosses the gutter once before The Moose model, and ends in the close's one plate.

Lane Lines and nothing added: one flat cream floor, a navy close and footer (.dark), one ink at token weights, plates for actions, floor lettering in Poppins ExtraBold set tight. / carries a studio floor and a member floor behind an audience switch, both in the same grammar.

Anti-references: the aggregator (dense venue grids, discount badges, consumer search results) and the brand-book v2 card page this replaced (bands, white cards on shadows, pink eyebrows and pink headline words).
keyCharacteristics: Two lanes and a gutter from 1048px; one lane with partner blocks stepped in below
One pink element per floor: the live line, drawn by scroll
Flat floors: no card, shadow, blur, pill or status colour
Actions are plates; one filled plate per viewport
Floor lettering is the only display voice, sentence case with a trailing period
A full-bleed square-cornered photograph as the hero's counterweight

rules.name: The One Live Line Rule
rules.body: A floor spends its one pink on the live line. No pink word, eyebrow, stat or link on /.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Text and marks are ink at its token weights, never grey, black or a status colour. The navy floor gets white ink from .dark.

rules.name: The Painted Line Rule
rules.body: Lettering is a sentence: sentence case, trailing period, wraps where the measure says.

rules.name: The Informative Label Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above lettering. Lane Lines has no eyebrow; a station label appears only when it carries a fact the reader would otherwise lose.

rules.name: The Lane Grid
rules.body: Every station is a lanes grid: your lane, gutter, partner lane, paired blocks level; one lane with partner blocks stepped in below 1048px.

rules.name: The Flat Floor Rule
rules.body: No shadow, blur, glass or gradient on the floor. The floor scrim over a photograph is the one exception, always the floor colour.

dos: Do take every value from a --m-* token; mark a missing one provisional and propose it upstream.
Do put new stations on the lane grid: lettering on your lane, matter on the partner lane.
Do keep exactly one filled plate per viewport; outline plates are in a set or trail a row of text.
Do set lettering in sentence case with a trailing period.
Do keep the live line the floor's one pink element; mark where it crosses and ends.
Do keep hit targets at 44px or more and measure contrast (RULES 16, 17).
donts: Don't put a card, chip, pill, shadow, blur or status colour on a Lane Lines floor.
Don't put an eyebrow or kicker above lettering, or a pink word inside it.
Don't box a figure, a partner mark or a non-action.
Don't extend the card-world utilities to new surfaces; they exist for the carve-out pages only.
